say:3:1610812002:0.text: Professor! Are you judging the exam today?
say:3:1610812002:0.source_cn: 娑丽丝老师！今天是你做考试评委吗？

say:4:1610812003:0.text: Oh, no, not this time. The judges are Magister Cyran and Headmistress Durella. Professor Hepler and I are just here to keep things running smoothly—and to make sure everyone follows the rules, of course.
say:4:1610812003:0.source_cn: 不是的，评委当然还是迪尔格雷大人与杜瑞拉女士。我会和赫...

say:6:1610812004:0.text: Is the exam location right here?
say:6:1610812004:0.source_cn: 娑丽丝老师，考试地点就在这里吗？

say:7:1610812005:0.text: That's right. The entire forest is part of the exam grounds. We've even set up a little... surprise for you all out there. You'll see what I mean soon enough.
say:7:1610812005:0.source_cn: 整个空境森林都是考场，而且我们还设置了一个很特别的区域...

say:8:1610812006:0.text: If you have questions later, come find me after the exam. I'll be happy to explain everything then. For now, I'm afraid I can't spoil the surprise.
say:8:1610812006:0.source_cn: 各位同学，如果你们还有什么疑惑，可以在考试结束之后再来...

say:9:1610812007:0.text: Alright. Before we begin, there's a small magical aptitude test. Think of it as a warmup. Pass this, and you'll move on to the real thing.
say:9:1610812007:0.source_cn: 好了，在正式考试之前，你们还要进行一个魔法能力测试，通...

choice_prompt:10:1610812007.text: Alright. Before we begin, there's a small magical aptitude test. Think of it as a warmup. Pass this, and you'll move on to the real thing.
choice_prompt:10:1610812007.source_cn: 好了，在正式考试之前，你们还要进行一个魔法能力测试，通过测试的同学就可以开始考试了。

say:11:1610812008:0.text: *Chuckle* Don't worry, it's nothing too demanding. We just need to confirm that everyone's basic magic is stable and ready. You've all worked so hard to get here; this is simply to make sure you can show your best selves.
say:11:1610812008:0.source_cn: 哈哈，别担心，只是一个很简单的测验，为了确定你们掌握了...

say:12:1610812009:0.text: Professor Hepler will explain the details. He's waiting just ahead.
say:12:1610812009:0.source_cn: 具体的测试内容将由赫普老师负责，他在前面等你们。

choice:10:0:1.text: Another test? Before the real one?!
choice:10:0:1.male: Another test? Before the real one?!
